description: Label schema for the 5-class in-bed sleep posture and repositioning classification model trained in Edge Impulse Studio.

classes.label: supine
classes.description: Patient lying horizontally on their back. Maximum compressive loading concentrated over sacrum, coccyx, and heels.
classes.clinical_risk: High sacral and heel ischemia risk. PTI integration threshold: 90 minutes.

classes.label: right_lateral_30
classes.description: Recommended 30-degree tilt onto the right side using therapeutic wedge support. Offloads sacrum and right greater trochanter.
classes.clinical_risk: Optimal therapeutic posture. Reperfusion of sacral capillary bed.

classes.label: left_lateral_30
classes.description: Recommended 30-degree tilt onto the left side using therapeutic wedge support. Offloads sacrum and left greater trochanter.
classes.clinical_risk: Optimal therapeutic posture. Reperfusion of sacral capillary bed.

classes.label: fowler
classes.description: Semi-Fowler or High-Fowler position with head-of-bed elevated between 30 and 45 degrees. Generates severe shear stress at the sacral-fascial junction.
classes.clinical_risk: Severe shear and microvascular occlusion. Maximum recommended duration: 60 minutes.

classes.label: prone
classes.description: Patient lying face down. Offloads the entire dorsal skeletal axis. Loading concentrated at patella, iliac crests, and chest.
classes.clinical_risk: Dorsal ulcer relief; monitoring required for airway patency.
